test_title: PYST 2: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Ramayana is an ancient Sanskrit epic; it is believed to be written around 500 BC to 100 BC.
solution:
The correct answer is '2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The title of the ancient Sanskrit epic should include the article "The."
 
• In English, titles of specific texts or works, particularly classical ones, often include a definite article to denote something specific.

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence:

*The Ramayana is an ancient Sanskrit epic; it is believed to be written around 500 BC to 100 BC.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In literary and historical contexts, the use of "The" before titles like "The Ramayana" is standard to clarify the reference to a well-known work.
 
• For example, similarly, we say "The Odyssey" and "The Iliad."
